chunks: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, used to say in the qunut of the Witr prayer:

O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being to, take me under Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless me in what You have given, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. Indeed, You decree and none may decree over You. Glory be to You, Lord of the House. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance. I believe in You and rely upon You. There is no power and no strength except through You, O Most Merciful.

key_terms.أَتَوَكَّلُ: I place my trust and reliance
key_terms.الْوَتْرِ: the Witr prayer, the odd-numbered concluding night prayer
key_terms.اهْدِنِي: guide me; grant me divine guidance
key_terms.تَوَلَّنِي: take me into Your care and guardianship
key_terms.عَافِنِي: grant me well-being, safety, and protection
key_terms.قُنُوتِ: the supplicatory invocation recited in salat (prayer), here in Witr

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say in the qunut of the Witr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith records a supplication recited by the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in the qunut of the Witr prayer. It combines requests for guidance, well-being, divine care, blessing, and protection with expressions of tawhid, repentance, faith, and trust in Allah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1402 - The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, would say in the Qunoot (supplication) of the Witr prayer:

Allahumma ihdini fi man hadayt, wa ‘afini fi man ‘afayt, wa tawallani fi man tawallayt, wa barik li fima a‘tayt, wa qini sharra ma qadayt, fa-innaka taqdi wa la yuqda ‘alayk. Subhanaka Rabb al-Bayt, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk, wa uminu bika wa atawakkalu ‘alayk. La hawla wa la quwwata illa bik, ya Raheem
"O’ Allah (swt), guide me among those You have guided, and grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being to, and take me under Your care among those You have taken into Your care, and bless me in what You have given, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. Indeed, You decree and no one can decree over You. Glory be to You, Lord (azj) of the House. I seek Your forgiveness and I turn to You in repentance. I believe in You and rely upon You. There is no power nor strength except with You, O’ Most Merciful."
